question.text: In which of the following pairs the two species are not isostructural?

solution.text:
(1) $\mathrm{CO}_3^{2-}$ \& $\mathrm{NO}_3^{-} \rightarrow \mathrm{Sp}^2$ hybridized, Trigonal planar
(2) $\mathrm{PCl}_4^{+}$\& $\mathrm{SiCl}_4 \rightarrow \mathrm{Sp}^3$ hybridized, Tetrahedral
(3) $\mathrm{PF}_5 \rightarrow \mathrm{Sp}^3 \mathrm{d}$ hybridized, Trigonal bipyramidal
$\mathrm{BrF}_5 \rightarrow \mathrm{Sp}^3 \mathrm{d}^2$ hybridized, square pyramidal
(4) $\mathrm{AlF}_6^{3-}$ \& $\mathrm{SF}_6 \rightarrow \mathrm{Sp}^3 \mathrm{d}^2$ hybridized, octahedral
